work.text: A data generator: Python code that, from a shared seed, yields synthetic time series to train a small forecasting model. The miner ships code only, no weights and no GPU, and commits an encrypted pointer on chain that unlocks before the round boundary. What is paid for is a generator whose data trains a Toto2-4M forecaster that beats the king's on private real-world windows.
work.quote: miners write the synthetic data generators that train it. Better data trains a better forecaster

scoring.text: King and challenger each train a Toto2-4M from a shared init on their generator's data. Validators score both on the same private held-out windows by the geometric mean of CRPS and MASE, lower is better. A paired bootstrap of 10,000 resamples gives a one-sided 95 percent lower bound on the challenger's relative improvement; it wins if that bound clears the margin. An uncomputable bound is inconclusive and the king holds.
scoring.quote: The challenger *wins the round* iff that LCB clears the win margin

split.text: Geometric decay across the lineage. The current king plus up to 4 prior kings still registered are paid in proportion to 0.5 to the power of their distance from the throne, about 52, 26, 13, 6 and 3 percent. A deregistered prior king drops out and the rest renormalize; with no valid king everything burns to UID 0. The dethrone margin is 0.01 fresh, 0.005 after 8 rounds.
split.quote: reward_prior_kings = 4 ... king_decay = 0.5 # geometric decay across [king, prior kings]
split.disagrees: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md at the pinned commit still says the validator sets an equal share across the current king plus up to reward_prior_kings prior kings; chain.toml at the same commit sets king_decay 0.5, cascade/validator/loop.py passes it to decayed_share_vector, and the README and llms.txt give about 52/26/13/6/3 percent.

judges.text: Seven validators were active on the 2026-09-09 chain snapshot, of 64 permitted; the margin rollout doc counts 6 external validators. Weights are committed then revealed, at most once per 100 blocks. Training runs on the owner's trainer on rented pods under one shared seed; each validator downloads the king's and finalists' checkpoints, scores them itself on private windows, runs the bootstrap verdict, and publishes a signed receipt cascade-audit can replay.
judges.quote: commit_reveal_weights_enabled True, weights_rate_limit 100, max_validators 64; chain-2026-09-09.json active_validators 7

cadence.text: Emission settles every 360 blocks, about 72 minutes, but the puzzle turns every 3,600 blocks: a round of about 12 hours with boundaries near 08:30 and 20:30 UTC, an encrypted reveal 25 blocks before the boundary, a one-hour heat and a five-hour final. Rounds without funded seats run nothing and the king holds. A new registration is immune from deregistration for 5,000 blocks, about 16 hours.
cadence.disagrees: The README at the pinned commit announces rolling intake next: 3 hour settlements against a king trained once per 12 hour era, switched on when 51 percent of validator stake signals readiness on chain; chain.toml at the same commit keeps epoch_blocks 3600 with rolling_from_block and era_king_from_block at 0, and whether the on-chain lock-in has fired was not checked.

buyer.text: Nobody. The chain URL cascadesub.net did not resolve on 2026-09-19; testnet.cascadesub.net serves a scoreboard of rounds, reigns and model error with no product, price, API or customer. The README describes the output as a trained forecaster checkpoint, and every crowned king's generator code is published. The miner's income is emission.
buyer.quote: King-of-the-hill · compete on synthetic data · Bittensor
buyer.disagrees: On 2026-09-22 cascadesub.net resolves and redirects to dashboard.cascadesub.net, the mainnet scoreboard of rounds, reigns and model error; it still shows no product, price, API or customer.

exploits.text: Copying a rival's generator: exact-identity dedup on the file tree, the normalized token stream and the stream with names masked, plus a behavioral probe for identical output; the earliest reveal keeps the slot and dropped copies still burn the hotkey. A similarity threshold was tried and removed after operators spaced variants just under it and it produced one false drop. Jitter-duplicated channels: a 0.999 correlation gate, in shadow.
exploits.quote: a ratio bar is gameable by construction
